items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1967-11-15
items.q: And Joe gave me the chills.

ctx.x: I thought he played that Spanish number. Duke. I was standing right alongside Baby Dots, looking at that music. He said, now, if I could get that man, I'd be on top of the world.

I said, well, they're two brothers, they're together. I said, I can't stop him. I don't give him. But he could have went the next day. Because if he just said, yeah, you want to go, I wouldn't accept for two weeks. I said, go on. I let him go. It's like going on Hawkins. You know what that band New York? They had to mainly kick him out of the band. Make him go to England. Coleman Hawkins, you know what you're talking about in that saxophone play tennis sax? Yeah. Great. He don't put no more than this, look. And…
He said, why you didn't tell him you told him you were saxophone player? He said, I play sax. But I heard you practicing downstairs. That was enough for me. So I'm going to play clandest.
